Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for your project has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally projected, and this has moved our delivery timeline by two weeks. The certification process involves external review stages that are outside our direct control, and the additional time has been necessary to ensure the integration meets the required standards before it goes live.

Based on the revised certification schedule, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April. Our team is continuing to work on all other components in parallel so that this delay does not affect any other part of the project, and we will move forward with final integration and testing as soon as certification is confirmed.

Does the new date of 14 April work with your internal planning, or are there specific milestones on your end we should coordinate around? We will keep you updated as certification progresses and will flag immediately if anything changes. Thank you for your continued patience and partnership on this project.
